content.short: THORChain swaps native BTC, ETH and other assets across chains directly, with no wrapped tokens or bridges.
content.description: Most cross-chain swaps use wrapped tokens. THORChain avoids them by holding native assets in vaults on each supported chain, controlled by its validator network. A user sends real BTC and receives real ETH, ATOM or BNB in return. Liquidity providers deposit one side of a pool and earn swap fees and RUNE rewards. Many self-custody wallets and aggregators route their cross-chain swaps through THORChain behind the scenes. It now supports Monero swaps and has a second token, TCY, alongside RUNE. Developers integrate through an agent toolkit and XChainJS, and partners such as Rujira build on top of it.
